meta.rule: Screens are assembled only from components in component-registry.json and tokens in tokens.json. "(to build)" means the component is missing: build it first, lower tiers first.
meta.dark_mode: duplicate the frame and set the Semantic / Schemes mode to Dark; never duplicate components

sign_in.use: Email/password sign in with optional social login.
sign_in.layout: single column, max width 400 (web) / full width with margins (mobile), vertically centered on large screens

sections.name: Header
components: Top bar (Organism, to build) (mobile only, back action)

sections.name: Actions
components: Button Type=Filled Size=base (Sign in, full width)

sections.name: Actions
components: Button Type=Filled Size=base (Create account, disabled until valid)

otp_verification.use: Verify a code sent by SMS or email.

sections.name: Header
sections.content: title, "We sent a code to ...", masked destination

sections.name: Code
components: OTP / Field (6 cells, auto-advance, paste support)

sections.name: Actions
components: Button Type=Link (Resend code, disabled with countdown)

sections.name: Top
components: Tabs / Item — Underline or filter chips (optional)

sections.name: Items
components: List item (Molecule, to build) x N (leading Avatar / icon, title, supporting text, trailing Badge or chevron)
sections.rules: virtualized; pull to refresh on mobile; pagination or infinite scroll

detail.use: One item with its info and actions.

sections.name: Top
components: Top bar (Organism, to build) (back, title, more actions)

sections.name: Hero
sections.content: image or Avatar, title (3xl/Semi Bold), meta, Badge

sections.name: Content
components: List item (Molecule, to build) rows for attributes

sections.name: Actions
components: Button Type=Filled Size=base (main action, sticky bottom on mobile)

sections.name: Fields
sections.rules: one column on mobile; labels above fields; hint between label and field; error below field; group related fields with section headers

sections.name: Groups
components: List item (Molecule, to build) with trailing Toggle / chevron / value
sections.rules: section headers; destructive row (Sign out, Delete account) last, danger color, opens Confirmation Popup

empty_state.use: No data yet, first-run, or no results.
